source_caption_text:
My right AirPod when I’m saying hi to my grandma:

YoungBoy Never Broke Again’s “Lil Top” is one of those tracks that immediately reminds you why his early 2020 run was so crazy. Released in 2020 as part of *Still Flexin, Still Steppin*, the song captures him at his most aggressive, going straight at the beat with nonstop energy.

His delivery is what really makes the track hit. YoungBoy switches between rapid bars and melodic moments without letting up, giving the song that intense Louisiana rap energy he became known for. “Lil Top” feels like one of those songs where he barely takes a breath from start to finish.

The music video matches that energy too, with YoungBoy surrounded by his people and showing off the lifestyle that came with his rise. Years later, “Lil Top” still stands out as one of the tracks that represents that era of YoungBoy perfectly.
